title: Recover Files
subtitle: Bring together the pieces your friends kept safe.
page_description: Each friend received one piece. Bring enough of them together here and the files will unlock, right on this device. The pieces and the files stay with you.
step1_drop: Drop a piece here, or click to choose a file
step1_hint: A friend's README, bundle, or recover.html
step2_drop: Drop recover.html or MANIFEST.age here, or click to choose it
step2_hint: MANIFEST.age from a friend's bundle — or, if their bundle has none, their recover.html
complete_subtitle: Download them and keep them somewhere private.
files_list_unavailable: This browser couldn't list what's inside, but the files are unlocked. Download them and open the downloaded file on your computer.
paste_btn: Paste a piece or type recovery words
paste_placeholder: Paste a piece, or type the recovery words
contact_list: The others who hold a piece
contact_list_hint: When it's time, these are the people to reach out to.
scan_hint: Point your camera at the QR code on a friend's printed copy
error_invalid_words_title: The recovery words couldn't be read
error_invalid_words_guidance: Check that all 25 words match the printed list, in the same order, with none missing or repeated.
error_not_ready_message: The recovery tool is still loading.
error_invalid_share_title: This doesn't look like a piece
error_invalid_share_message: There's no piece in "{0}" that can be read.
error_invalid_share_guidance: Try the README file from a bundle, or the whole bundle. If you were sent text, include everything from its first line to its last.
error_no_share_guidance: Each friend's piece is in the README file of their bundle. Check that this is the right file.
error_duplicate_guidance: Each piece only counts once. Add one from someone else.
error_mismatch_message: This piece belongs to a different set of bundles.
error_mismatch_guidance: It may be from an older set, or from someone else's. Ask whoever sent it whether they have a newer bundle.
warning_created_message: This piece was made at a different time than the others.
warning_created_guidance: It may be from an older set of bundles. It's been added anyway. If the files don't open, remove it and try another piece.
error_file_read_guidance: The file may be damaged. Ask for it to be sent again.
error_bundle_extract_title: This doesn't look like a bundle
error_bundle_extract_guidance: Use the bundle ZIP as it was sent, from you or from a friend.
error_unrecognized_file_title: Not sure what to do with this
error_unrecognized_file_message: "{0}" doesn't seem to hold a piece or the locked files.
error_unrecognized_file_guidance: Try the README, recover.html, or bundle ZIP from one of the bundles.
error_html_no_share_guidance: This recover.html doesn't hold a piece. Ask your friend to send their bundle again, or use their README file instead.
error_paste_no_share_message: There's no piece in the pasted text.
error_paste_no_share_guidance: Copy everything from a friend's README file, from 'BEGIN REMEMORY SHARE' to 'END REMEMORY SHARE'. You can also type the recovery words.
error_decrypt_message: These pieces don't open these locked files.
error_decrypt_guidance: One piece may be from an older set of bundles. If you have more pieces than you need, try leaving one out.
error_decrypt_status: The files didn't open. Check the pieces and try again.
error_extract_message: The files were unlocked, but they couldn't be opened.
error_extract_guidance: The locked files may be damaged. Ask another friend for their recover.html or MANIFEST.age and try again.
error_extract_status: The files were unlocked but couldn't be opened. They may be damaged.
error_recovery_guidance: Check that the pieces and the locked files come from the same set of bundles, then try again.
error_corrupt_embedded_manifest_title: This copy of recover.html is damaged
error_corrupt_embedded_manifest_message: Part of the locked files inside this recover.html is missing.
error_corrupt_embedded_manifest_guidance: Ask a friend to send their recover.html, and add it in step 2.
error_preloaded_share_message: The piece in this recover.html couldn't be read.
error_preloaded_share_guidance: You can still add pieces: drop a friend's README file below, or paste one in.
tlock_waiting_message: Opens {0}. Wait here, or come back later.
tlock_no_support: These files have a time lock. Open them with the recover.html from a bundle.
tlock_error_title: The time lock couldn't be checked
tlock_error_message: Your pieces worked, but checking the time lock needs a brief internet connection, and the page couldn't get through.
tlock_error_guidance: Try again with an internet connection, or in a different web browser. If it still doesn't open, download the locked files and ask someone comfortable with computers to open them with the ReMemory program.
tlock_error_status: The time lock couldn't be checked. Your pieces are correct — try again with an internet connection.
verification_manifest_ok: The locked files are in this bundle too.
verification_manifest_missing: You'll also need the locked files: MANIFEST.age, from your bundle.
verification_keep_safe: If you're only checking your bundle, there's nothing else to do.
verification_time_come: If the time has come, the friends listed below hold the other pieces.
verification_time_come_anon: If the time has come, reach out to the others who hold a piece.
